title: Binance Hackers Swap About $50 Million of Stolen XRP Mostly Into Bitcoin, Elliptic Says
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Binance Hackers Swap About $50 Million of Stolen XRP Mostly Into Bitcoin, Elliptic Says About 42 million stolen XRP, worth roughly $50 million, has been swapped mostly into bitcoin via THORChain, Elliptic said, lifting converted bitcoin from the Binance theft to about 1,650 BTC. This post Binance Hackers Swap About $50 Million of Stolen XRP Mostly Into Bitcoin, Elliptic Says first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
